title: Ask Tracy prepares the new session and sends a native user brief before provision
steps: Run deterministic demo chat navigation tests.
expect: An accepted action waits for its real server-created chat, then opens once.
Leaving the screen or cancelling an in-flight read prevents navigation.
Another action, old workflow or unsafe destination never opens.
Retry preserves the conversation and bulk opens one accepted demo.
New client-send actions prepare an exact session before installing CMS and submit through the native composer.
Reload, uncertainty and two tabs reuse the winning native request ID; no backend prompt is sent.
The queued demo can reopen its existing chat without creating another build.
